title: Box of Oddfire Fireworks

sources.title: Colour Spray
markers: | description = {{Cond|Blinded|Blind}} creatures up to a combined {{DamageColor|Healing|'''33 Hit Points'''}}.

summary: Ignite the box with Fire to launch a rocket. The blast deals 8d6 Fire and applies Colour Spray to the target.

fields.Activation: Ignite with a source of Fire.
fields.Blast: 8d6 Fire to target and nearby creatures. Colour Spray can Blind the target. The item source gives no blast radius.
fields.Base value: 5 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence.
